name: Shechem
overview: Shechem, also called Sichem or Sychem, is a significant location in biblical history, situated in the central land of Canaan where Abraham journeyed and Jacob purchased land from Hamor, the father of Shechem (Genesis 12:6; 33:19). It served as a pastoral area where Jacob's family tended their flocks (Genesis 37:12) and was allotted to the tribe of Manasseh, including the family of Shechem (Numbers 26:31; Joshua 17:2). Shechem also functioned as a city of refuge in Mount Ephraim (Joshua 20:7), highlighting its spiritual and communal importance in Israel's history.
